## About
Native Camera2 camera app for Rokid RV101, with live preview, photos, video recording, configurable preview position, and temple-button controls. This entry uses the upstream public 2.6.1 APK. Button events and camera behavior depend on firmware; the project README does not establish physical RV101 validation.
